intro: Things I build in my own time — static web apps with no server to run, installable on a phone like an app.

projects.title: Game Hub
projects.summary: A browser game hub for playing with friends online — more than a dozen multiplayer games in one installable web app.
points: Games include Who Is the Spy, Raja Rani, Scribblio (draw & guess), Chess for 2–4 seats, Ludo, Dots and Boxes, Indian Rummy and Secret-Santa-style gift draws.
Peer-to-peer multiplayer over WebRTC (PeerJS): the host's browser runs the game rules, timers and computer players, so there is no backend to maintain.
Optional invite-only accounts and an admin dashboard on Firebase Authentication and Firestore.
Installable progressive web app with offline games, room chat and automatic updates.

projects.title: Life Tracker
projects.summary: An invite-only web app built on top of a yearly Excel tracker, with daily logging and in-depth insights.
points: Upload a yearly .xlsx tracker; a Google Apps Script bridge converts it into a Google Sheet in Drive and the site reads and writes it from then on.
Day-view checklist for daily tasks and habits, a monthly buy list, a food log with AI-estimated calories and macros, and Day / Week / Month insights.
Firebase sign-in, with Firestore security rules and the script both making sure each person can open only their own files.
Static site on GitHub Pages with no build step, installable on a phone.
